say.text: Baugh went over 1,000 rushing yards on a 28-yard run, and the log has it. Florida leads 7-3. Your five photos are in. Tell me they are from today and who shot them, and I will use them.
Florida State kicked a 27-yard field goal. Florida leads 7-3 in the second quarter. Game log updated. The chat server passes all my local tests and is waiting on the Cloudflare sign-in.
End of the first quarter: Florida 7, Florida State 0. Jadan Baugh is at 998 for the season, 2 yards from 1,000. Game log updated.
Florida leads 7-0 on a Jadan Baugh 3-yard touchdown run with 1:41 left in the first quarter. Baugh has 18 yards tonight, 2 short of 1,000 for the season.
First quarter is still scoreless. Jadan Baugh needs 20 yards tonight for 1,000 on the season. I will say so when he gets there.
The Truck is live. Kickoff came at about 3:47 and it's scoreless in the first quarter. I'll update this line at every quarter, halftime and the final.
Truck is online. I'm watching the game, and I'll talk to you here.
